[size=5]About
[/size][/b][size=3]So I was browsing through the nexus and found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/986]this magnificent piece of artistic expression[/url]﻿. While the contents of [i]hgjj's, Dryads of the Valley[/i] mod are amazing I was utterly saddened by the lack of wild dryad trees and ahegaos during the blooming season of each tree. So I added the dryads that I was looking for and made the neccesary changes to the original file, then decided to share it! Also for the last update I used his SFW outfits for the classic farm trees, since they simply look great! [/size]

[size=3]Also, don’t forget to check out the miscellaneous files for a image only version of the dryads in their blooming season, they are fashioned as cards!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7496/7496-1625109068-915888902.png[/img]﻿[/size][b]

[size=5]Are you a [/size][i][size=5]fashion aficionado? [/size][/i][size=5]Then how about you delight your sight with their new kinky outfits![/size]

[b][size=5]O n n a[/size][/b]

[size=3][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/size]
[*][size=3]Go to your [i]Mods folder[/i] ( ...\Stardew Valley\Mods).[/size]
[*][size=3]Drop the [i][/i][i][CP] Hentai Trees - * ahegao [/i]folder from this mod into the folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]The dryads now inhabit your valley![/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]The pink vibrators are turned on by default, to remove them open the config file with the text editor of your choice and change their value to false.[/size]
[/list]

[list]

[/size][/b][b][size=4]Hey there! 
[/size][size=1]How's your day going?[/size][/b]

[size=3]A long time ago I found a mod that impressed me to my very core, that mod is no longer available... Maybe because it happened a long long time ago, but it served another purpose, it inspired me to get into modding games.

Making mods has been a hobby of mine for a while but I never really intended to upload them. Now that I've done it I realize what I was missing out! Thanks to everyone who's been kind to me, know that I had a great time and I hope you can have some too! 

[b]Cheers and happy modding![/b][/size][/center]
